usage: Used as a general noun for a tree. It is the everyday word in Hong Kong Cantonese and works in both speech and writing.
Commonly used with classifiers like 一棵樹, 呢棵樹, 嗰棵樹. The classifier 棵 is the natural choice for plants and trees.
Can refer to a single tree or trees in general, depending on context. For the plural idea, Cantonese often relies on context rather than adding a plural ending.
Very common in nature, gardening, and everyday descriptions. It is neutral in register and easy to use in basic sentences.
